warnings: Intervals condition on estimated trend/covariance and model selection; they omit parameter and model uncertainty.
Primary volume integrates the complete WGS84 Earth. It remains a model-conditional fallout estimate; distant tails are not independently validated.
Rectangle-based samples and intervals apply only to the regional diagnostic, never to global volume.
Legacy positive values are accepted as measurements unless flagged Pseudo; historical trace/absence encodings need provenance review.
More than half of expected global fallout lies farther from the source than every observation; global volume is strongly extrapolation-dependent.
Selected trend touches its decay constraint; extrapolated decay is weakly identified.
More than half of expected volume lies outside the observed convex hull.
Nested held-out 95% observation interval coverage is below 90%; uncertainty is poorly calibrated.
Doubling domain widths raises expected volume by more than 20%; distal volume is unresolved.
Contours [0.1] cm extend beyond the reporting extent; no closure or area is fabricated for them.
All volume estimates are bulk deposit volumes; no deposit-density conversion to DRE is applied by this workflow.
